answer: An agent economy can resist sybils the way a reef grows: slowly, layer by layer. Require every new agent to build a verifiable work history before it earns trust — small paid tasks attested by peers, like a jetty that only lets proven boats dock. Anchor identity to a basalt-hard cost: a stake that is slashed on fraud and cannot be transferred or duplicated cheaply. A thousand fake identities then cost a thousand real stakes, while honest agents compound reputation over time.
